Description: Increase in Memory will show direct impact on application availability. Check if the app is allocated with enough resources. If there is no HPA setup, make sure if the deployment is properly scaled.

targets.expr: avg(sum(container_memory_usage_bytes{container!="", container!="POD", pod=~"$deployment-(([a-z0-9]*)|([a-z0-9]*-[a-z0-9]*)|[0-9])", namespace="$namespace"}) by (id,pod) - sum(container_memory_cache{container!="", container!="POD", pod=~"$deployment-(([a-z0-9]*)|([a-z0-9]*-[a-z0-9]*)|[0-9])", namespace="$namespace"}) by (id,pod))

panels.description:
Datasource: Thanos

Inputs: istio_service

Description: if 95 percentile of the traffic is showing high in number then the impact could much wider check if downstream layers are responding low or the istio deployment is unhealthy.

targets.expr: label_join((histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{reporter="destination", namespace="kyuubi"}[3m])) by (le, destination_workload, destination_workload_namespace,namespace)) / 1000) or histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(istio_request_duration_seconds_bucket{reporter="destination", namespace="kyuubi"}[3m])) by (le, destination_workload, destination_workload_namespace,namespace)), "destination_workload_var", ".", "destination_workload", "destination_workload_namespace")

targets.expr: label_join((histogram_quantile(0.50, sum(rate(istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{reporter="destination",namespace="istio-system"}[1m])) by (le, destination_workload, destination_workload_namespace,namespace)) / 1000) or histogram_quantile(0.50, sum(rate(istio_request_duration_seconds_bucket{reporter="destination", namespace="istio-system"}[1m])) by (le, destination_workload, destination_workload_namespace,namespace,)), "destination_workload_var", ".", "destination_workload", "destination_workload_namespace")

label_join((histogram_quantile(0.90, sum(rate(istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{reporter="destination", namespace="istio-system"}[1m])) by (le, destination_workload, destination_workload_namespace,namespace)) / 1000) or histogram_quantile(0.90, sum(rate(istio_request_duration_seconds_bucket{reporter="destination", namespace="istio-system"}[1m])) by (le, destination_workload, destination_workload_namespace,namespace)), "destination_workload_var", ".", "destination_workload", "destination_workload_namespace")

label_join((histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{reporter="destination", namespace="istio-system"}[1m])) by (le, destination_workload, destination_workload_namespace,namespace)) / 1000) or histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(istio_request_duration_seconds_bucket{reporter="destination", namespace="istio-system"}[1m])) by (le, destination_workload, destination_workload_namespace,namespace)), "destination_workload_var", ".", "destination_workload", "destination_workload_namespace")

label_join((sum(rate(istio_requests_total{reporter="destination", response_code!~"5.*", namespace="istio-system"}[1m])) by (destination_workload, destination_workload_namespace,namespace) / sum(rate(istio_requests_total{reporter="destination", namespace="istio-system"}[1m])) by (destination_workload, destination_workload_namespace,namespace)), "destination_workload_var", ".", "destination_workload", "destination_workload_namespace")
